## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new `--exclude` flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure exclusions through the environment as required by project policy.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames, logs skipped paths, and leaves matching files out of the archive. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, the archive still includes `debug.log` because the parser hard-codes `default=[]`. The CLI policy says every new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`). — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment package files they intended to omit.
